mods.name: Ore Overhaul - Lithium and Ruby
mods.author: scooby1337
mods.description: Adds minable Lithium and Ruby ore nodes to Olympus, Styx and Prometheus (Elysium spawn weights). No changes to existing ores.

mods.name: Synthetic Miasma
mods.author: scooby1337
mods.description: Craft Crystallised Miasma at the Chemistry Bench on maps without a swamp (Olympus, Styx): 3 Scorpion Tail -> Venom Sac; 3 Poison Paste + 2 Poison Sac + 1 Venom Sac -> Crystallised Miasma. Adds 2 recipes, changes nothing else.
